descriptive_qualified_ip_subset.limitation: Post-run descriptive subset; does not satisfy complete30-pair IP qualification and is not a substitute for the registered full campaign
descriptive_qualified_ip_subset.selection_rule: All and only complete capture shards, selected by recorded completeness rather than measured byte reduction; incomplete shard retained in full30-trial application/CPU/wall results

ip_measurement.attribution: Each row owns the complete observed TCP connection lifetime including delayed ACKs and teardown; setup and unattributed traffic remain separate campaign counters
ip_measurement.byte_layer: IP header total lengths including TLS/HTTP/TCP overhead, ACKs and retransmissions; not physical Ethernet wire bytes
ip_measurement.paired_statistics: Global trial order; midpoint median and nearest-rank p95; paired raw/sparse and zstd/sparse geometric means; seed plus transfer added per trial before summarizing

limitations: Canonical fixture IDs regenerated independently and reopened verification receipts/checksums bound; independent analysis does not rerun persisted-byte comparison
Capture JSON partitions/body coverage and preserved offload/pinned-address evidence checked; independent raw PCAP replay is separate and does not reproduce individual connection ownership
Combined30-pair IP metrics require all three complete captures; any separately labeled complete-shard subset is descriptive and does not satisfy that full-campaign qualification
Measured runner-to-Cloudflare relay leg excludes relay-to-receiver traffic and is not full-path traffic
Receiver CPU covers protocol decode/handle/encode; sender plus receiver CPU is not energy
Application body savings do not measure complete network path bytes
Raw/zstd attempt bounded optional DAG warming; sparse skips it; this is not an equal-instruction CPU experiment
